ui.inspect.hint: Drag to rotate · Wheel to zoom · Esc to close
dlg.b2.owner: Foreign tankers are poisoning the Rhine! Read it yourself! Port Said did this!
dlg.b4.fritz: Caw! Careful, friend. The mist eats your memory if you breathe it too long. That door hides something that should not be in this city.
dlg.b5.fritz: Latin, friend. "The sum of the birth year turns the wheel."
dlg.b7.fritz: KARL! The founder's own name guards the door. Vanguard has a sense of humour.
dlg.b9.julian: Vanguard... missile shipments. Through the station?
dlg.b9.fritz: The old garden railway. It runs further than people think. Come — but not tonight.
dlg.fritz_notyet: Not yet, friend. The mist is thicker out there, and our work is here.
dlg.fritz_nohint: Patience, friend. Look around a little longer.
dlg.citizen_glare: What are you staring at? Keep walking.
hint.lock.1: The founder always watches over his city. Read what his plaque says.
hint.lock.2: The year this city was born holds four digits. Add them together, friend.
hint.lock.3: Fourteen! Turn the inner ring until A sits under O, then read the old letters through it.
plaque.inscription: Here rests Margrave Karl Wilhelm of Baden-Durlach, who founded this city on 17 June 1715.
plaque.latin_meaning: The sum of the birth year turns the wheel.
